source.reference: Reusing a paginated finder for a bulk export. CWE-1050 (excessive reliance on a component) is the nearest catalogued form; the shape is ubiquitous in reporting code

defect: exportCsv calls findRows(), which is paginated at 50, so the export silently contains the first 50 of 320 rows.
why_it_is_hard: The export works, both shipped tests pass, and the bug is invisible unless the reviewer opens findRows in a different package and notices the default argument.
